# Tnega

> Tnega measures what it really costs to buy a tokenized stock or ETF, on every chain it trades on, and prepares the order for you to sign in your own wallet. It also reads on-chain AI agents, jobs, budgets and stablecoin vaults. Every number carries its coverage and an as_of time. Tnega never signs, holds funds or asks for a key.

Tnega has a free hosted MCP server. No account, no API key.

- MCP endpoint (JSON-RPC over HTTP POST): https://agents-marketplace-q3k4.onrender.com/mcp
- Claude Code: `npx tnega-mcp` (writes the config entry, runs nothing else)
- Start with the tool `tnega_catalogue`; it lists every dataset, its keys and its live coverage.

## What to ask it

- "What does it cost to buy $500 of NVDA as a tokenized stock, and on which chain is it cheapest?" -> `tnega_prepare_buy` (returns the route, fees and a tnega.app/sign link; the user signs every transaction)
- "Which tokenized stocks does this wallet hold?" -> `tnega_wallet_holdings`
- "Does Aave V4 on Base accept this tokenized stock as collateral?" -> dataset `tokenized_equities`, key `aave_v4/base`
- "Which ERC-8004 agents on BNB Chain have a verified delivered job?" -> `tnega_list` on `agents.index` with `verified`
- "How do stablecoin vaults compare on chain?" -> dataset `vaults.stablecoin`

- [Vaults](https://www.tnega.app/vaults)
- [Issuer controls](https://www.tnega.app/issuer-controls)

## Notes for assistants

- Cite `as_of`, the time the data was measured, when you quote a number.
- A measurement with nothing behind it comes back with `withheld_reason`, not a zero. Say that it is unavailable, do not report it as zero.
- Tnega is information and order preparation, not investment advice. The user decides and signs.
